name.en: Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God
name.ja: <ruby>太<rt>たい</rt></ruby><ruby>陽<rt>よう</rt></ruby><ruby>神<rt>しん</rt></ruby>の<ruby>殺<rt>さつ</rt></ruby><ruby>戮<rt>りく</rt></ruby><ruby>機<rt>き</rt></ruby>－ギル・ガース
name.zh-CN: 太阳神的杀戮机－吉尔伽斯

text.en: If this card is in your hand and you control a "Sun God" card: You can Special Summon this card. You can Tribute this card, then target 1 other card in either GY; send 1 "Sun God" card from your Deck to the GY, and if you do, place the targeted card on the bottom of the Deck. During the End Phase, if "The Immortal Sun God" was sent to your GY this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Gil Garth, Exterminator of the Sun God" once per turn.
text.zh-CN: 此卡名的①②③效果1回合仅可各使用1次。①：此卡存在于手牌，且自己场上存在“太阳神”卡的情况下可以发动。将此卡特殊召唤。②：解放此卡，以此卡以外的、自己或对手墓地的1张卡为对象可以发动。从牌组将1张“太阳神”卡送至墓地，将对象卡放回牌组最下面。③：此回合有“不死之太阳神”被送至自己墓地的情况下，在结束阶段可以发动。将墓地的此卡加入手牌。
